item.title: Trusted access for the next era of cyber defense
The dangers of California's legislation to censor 3D printing
item.description:
📝 California must stand with creators and reject this legislation before it’s too late. Retailers will feel this pinch, but the second-hand market will feel it most acutely. But under this bill, such resale risks misdemeanor penalties.

item.title: Tell HN: Fiverr left customer files public and searchable
item.description:
📝 Besides the PDF processing value add, Cloudinary effectively acts like S3 here, serving assets directly to the web client. However, Fiverr opted to use public URLs, not signed ones, for sensitive client-worker communication. Moreover, it seems like they may be serving public HTML somewhere that links to these files.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47769796
